# My Learn Base

> A personal learning journal and portfolio by Efe Erhie. Logbooks of real
> software projects, the workflows behind them, opinions on tools and practice,
> curated resources, and interactive demos of the concepts involved — built in
> the open while learning.

## Posts
- [All posts](https://mylearnbase.com/posts/): every entry, grouped by form
- [Logbook](https://mylearnbase.com/posts/logbook/): build journals from real projects, feature by feature
- [Concepts](https://mylearnbase.com/posts/concepts/): interactive demos of the ideas behind the work
- [Workflows](https://mylearnbase.com/posts/workflows/): repeatable processes used across projects
- [Opinions](https://mylearnbase.com/posts/opinions/): takes on tools, practices, and trade-offs
- [Resources](https://mylearnbase.com/posts/resources/): curated references worth keeping
